"""Camera-guided controller for one peg insertion episode; no reset or simulator state access."""
import sys, json, pathlib
sys.path.insert(0, '/opt/tools')
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
from rcb_client import Robot

OUT=pathlib.Path('/app/output'); OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
r=Robot(); spec=r.spec(); cams=list(spec['cameras']); counter=0
(OUT/'spec.json').write_text(json.dumps(spec,indent=2))

def record(obs,label):
    global counter
    counter+=1
    p=OUT/f'{counter:03d}_{label}'; obs.save(str(p))
    for cam,im in obs.last.items(): Image.fromarray(im).save(p/f'{cam}.png')
    tiles=Image.new('RGB',(640,520))
    d=ImageDraw.Draw(tiles)
    for i,cam in enumerate(cams):
        if cam in obs.last:
            x=(i%2)*320; y=(i//2)*260
            tiles.paste(Image.fromarray(obs.last[cam]),(x,y+20));d.text((x+5,y+3),cam,fill='white')
    tiles.save(OUT/'latest.png')
    (OUT/'latest_dir.txt').write_text(str(p))
    print(json.dumps({'dir':str(p),'meta':obs.meta}),flush=True)
    return obs

obs=record(r.get_obs(cameras=cams,include_depth=True),'initial')
print('READY',flush=True)
for line in sys.stdin:
    try:
        c=json.loads(line)
        if c['op']=='observe':
            obs=record(r.get_obs(cameras=cams,include_depth=True,seconds=c.get('seconds',0)),c.get('label','observe'))
        elif c['op']=='act':
            a=np.asarray(c['actions'],dtype=np.float64)
            if a.ndim==1:a=np.tile(a,(c.get('n',1),1))
            obs=record(r.submit('ee_delta',a,dt=spec['control_dt'],cameras=cams,include_depth=True,video='both',note=c.get('label','act')),c.get('label','act'))
        elif c['op']=='move':
            target=np.asarray(c['target']);grip=c.get('grip',-1)
            for j in range(c.get('iterations',12)):
                p=dict(zip(obs.meta['proprio']['layout'],obs.meta['proprio']['now']))
                tcp=np.array([p[f'tcp_{a}'] for a in 'xyz'])
                err=target-tcp
                if np.max(np.abs(err))<c.get('tol',.002):break
                v=np.clip(err*c.get('gain',15),-c.get('speed',.5),c.get('speed',.5))
                a=np.tile(np.r_[v,grip],(c.get('chunk',8),1))
                obs=r.submit('ee_delta',a,dt=spec['control_dt'],cameras=cams,include_depth=True,video='frames',note=c.get('label','move'))
            record(obs,c.get('label','move'))
        elif c['op']=='stop':
            print('STOPPED: no more control steps.',flush=True);break
    except Exception as e:print('ERROR',repr(e),flush=True)

for cam,c in m['cameras'].items():
    im=np.array(Image.open(p/f'{cam}.png'));dep=np.load(p/f'depth_{cam}.npy').astype(float)
    mask=(im[:,:,1]>150)&(im[:,:,0]<150)&(im[:,:,2]<150)
    v,u=np.where(mask)
